✅ Correct Answer: A — Dijon-Prenois

📖 Explanation:

Rosberg won his sole 1982 race at the Swiss Grand Prix, held across the border at the Dijon-Prenois circuit in France on August 29, 1982.

Starting from eighth on the grid in his Williams-Ford FW08, Rosberg chased down Alain Prost's Renault, overtaking him with just two laps remaining to claim his maiden Formula 1 victory.

This single win, paired with five other podium finishes across the chaotic 1982 season, was enough to secure him the World Championship title by five points.
